text:
QUOTE: The argument value comes from `args_to_pattern`. It is the value of the first key in the args JSON object if that value is a string. Empty args, `{}`, an unparseable body, or a non-string first value all become `*`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: States that only one argument value (the first key's string) reaches the pattern, and non-string or unparseable args collapse to `*`; the "only the first argument value" scoping is also reinforced in risk #1.
